facebook.caption:
950 reviews. 4.4 stars. On a party island where half the bars disappear after one season.

The Rabbit Hole Irish Bar on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo earns it. Cold draft. Big screens. A crowd that actually shows up for the game.

$15-30 a head. Cold pint included in that math.

If you want a bar that delivers every single time, this is it.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
